page.overview:
Who is Tristram Bassenthwaite?

Tristram Bassenthwaite was a Slytherin student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the 1990s. He was seen walking around the school during the 1993–1994 school year.

Tristram is a Medieval English form of Tristan. Bassenthwaite is a real village in the Lake District.
